subject: DK vendor tax evidence + e-invoice routing for Zenta Logistics
messages:
From: Marta Nielsen <marta@zentalog.dk>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ap+zenta@zentalog.dk
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 08:17:00 +0100
Subject: Zenta onboarding docs for Redwood PO & e-invoicing

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attaching the Danish CVR extract and the EU VAT certificate so you can proceed with PO creation and e-invoice routing. We support PEPPOL e-invoicing (UBL XML) and can send test invoices to whatever connector you prefer.

Quick summary of attachments:
- CVR_certificate_8045321.pdf — company registration / VAT registration snapshot (issued 2026-12-01)
- EU_VAT_certificate_2026.pdf — VAT registration confirmation for ZENTA LOGISTICS A/S
- sample_invoice_with_vat.xml — UBL example with VAT line and GL coding suggestion

Couple of notes that came up internally:
- Zenta is registered in Denmark (CVR 80453219) and charged VAT on domestic services. For cross-border freight where Redwood is the importer of record we typically see reverse-charge, but we'd like Redwood to confirm how you handle freight VAT.
- Our AP team prefers the PO to reference your CVR and to receive invoices via SFTP to ap+zenta@zentalog.dk or via PEPPOL.

Next steps we need from Redwood:
1) Confirm which Redwood legal entity the PO should be addressed to (and whether you need the invoice routed to a European billing entity).
2) Confirm whether you will apply reverse-charge or expect Zenta to charge VAT.
3) Provide the PO template fields Redwood requires in UBL (we included a suggested mapping in the sample).

If helpful, Ole (cc'd on the thread here) can join a short call to iron out the PEPPOL connector test.

Best,
Marta
Finance & AP, Zenta Logistics A/S
attachments: CVR_certificate_8045321.pdf (PDF), EU_VAT_certificate_2026.pdf (PDF), sample_invoice_with_vat.xml (XML)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 10:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Zenta onboarding docs for Redwood PO & e-invoicing

Hi Marta — thank you for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Confirming we received the CVR and VAT cert.

A few items from our side so we can progress PO activation this week:
- Redwood legal entity: please address POs to "Redwood Inference EMEA B.V." (we will supply the full billing address and VAT id in the PO once routed). That means invoices for EU suppliers like Zenta should be routed to our EU AP pipeline.
- Tax treatment: Ben (cc'd) will confirm whether the freight items should be reverse-charged or billed with VAT.
- E-invoice: PEPPOL is preferred; we will provide our PEPPOL ID and test endpoint. SFTP is acceptable as fallback.

Action items for Zenta: please confirm the invoice remit email and whether your sample UBL includes your CVR in the <AccountingSupplierParty> block. Also include your bank IBAN + SWIFT on the invoices so our AP can map payments.

I'll loop Ben and Karthik to finalize tax and PO routing. Once Ben signs off we'll create the PO and share a DocuSign link for the master purchase terms.

Thanks —
Laura
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

- We need to confirm tax treatment for freight / logistics lines. My read: for services supplied in DK to an EU buyer without fixed establishment in DK, reverse-charge would often apply, but freight and import VAT complexity remains (depends on who is importer).

Please confirm the following so I can: (a) tell Marta which entity to invoice and (b) proceed with PO creation and DocuSign.
- Confirm target Redwood billing entity (I propose Redwood Inference EMEA B.V.)
- Confirm VAT handling for typical freight lines (reverse-charge vs Zenta charging VAT) and any withholding implications
- Any PO field requirements we should pass to Zenta (GL code field mapping, VAT rate codes, and where to put CVR)

Subject: Re: Fwd: Zenta onboarding docs for Redwood PO & e-invoicing

Thanks Laura — quick confirm from tax/AP side.

1) Billing entity: Confirmed. Use "Redwood Inference EMEA B.V." for the PO and have Zenta route invoices to our EU AP inbox (we will create a PO number under that entity). I'll follow up with the exact PEPPOL ID and the EU AP remit address in a separate note.

2) VAT treatment: For most cross-border freight where Redwood is the buyer and we are the importer of record, import VAT is paid at customs and generally recoverable by Redwood (subject to local reclaim rules). For the freight service lines supplied by Zenta to Redwood in Denmark, we expect reverse-charge should apply when the service is supplied to a taxable EU business established in another Member State — however, if the service is strictly domestic in DK and Zenta is charging VAT, we'll need their VAT-charged invoice and Redwood will reclaim via our EU VAT return.

Actionable items for Zenta (Marta / Ole):
- Please confirm whether the sample UBL includes your CVR in the Supplier block and ensure the <TaxScheme> element contains DK VAT with your VAT number.
- Please include IBAN and SWIFT on invoices.
- Please add the PO number field we will provide (PO to be created today) and include your invoice line-level VAT rate if charging VAT.

I'll create the PO under Redwood Inference EMEA B.V. once Laura confirms the PO fields. If Zenta prefers the PEPPOL test call, Karhik (cc) can coordinate schedules.

Ben Carter
Director, Global Tax & Treasury, Redwood Inference
